text: Based on the tool output, the asset is not deforestation-free. The observation data shows that there was tree cover in the year 2000, but by 2020, there was no forest cover observed. This indicates that deforestation has occurred on the asset. The data from both the University of Maryland (Hansen/UMD) and the European Commission Joint Research Centre (JRC) support this conclusion. Therefore, the asset has experienced deforestation.
